preopening_rows_handling.training: Excluded pre-opening zero rows based on earliest positive sale date per store (55,308 rows dropped post-2015)
preopening_rows_handling.evaluation: 0 pre-opening rows in evaluation; all stores open prior to test origin (Store 52 opened 2017-04-20)

parameters.extrapolation_handling: Using per-review-date re-forecasting (stitching_rule='reforecast') with 16-day horizon covering R+L=10d and 14d without proportional scaling.
parameters.data_limitations: Favorita has no inventory data; sales are a demand proxy and are censored by stockouts, so fill rates are optimistic; results are assumption-driven.
